name: Sphagesaurus
sum: Sphagesaurus is a sphagesaurid notosuchian crocodylomorph from the Late Cretaceous of south-western São Paulo, Brazil.
wsnote: No body-length estimate is given in the sources consulted.
holotype: DGM 332-R, an isolated molariform maxillary tooth found in a railway cut between Presidente Bernardes and Santo Anastácio, São Paulo.
material: The holotype and the referred tooth DGM 333-R from near Catanduva, both from the Bauru Group; later work referred further material.
biology: The sources consulted describe its teeth and classification but give no direct evidence of diet or habits.
author: Price 1950
